answer: Reaching eligibility takes 41 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary forfeits for every seat it wants. The jetty register is checked at draw time, cedar lists the eligible set, and falcon seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 41 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The bill scales 24 fold, not the vote. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
